title: Fill the Logic
story: The cinema lets you in only if you are old enough and hold a ticket.
goal: Fill the blank so a person needs both conditions.
hints: You need BOTH things to be true. Which word joins two conditions that must both hold?
socratic: Does the person need one condition or both?
Which keyword means both must be true?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what did the blank teach you in “Fill the Logic”?
